canonical_statement: For n >= 1, a measurable bounded domain Omega in R^n, p > n, alpha = 1 - n/p, and scalar W^{1,p}(Omega) data admitting the specified bounded W^{1,p} extension to R^n, there exists a representative agreeing almost everywhere on Omega that is alpha-Holder on closure Omega and obeys a quantitative sup/Holder bound by its W^{1,p}(Omega) norm.

canonical_formal_target.elaborated_expression: forall (n : Nat), 1 <= n -> forall (Omega : Set (Space n)), MeasurableSet Omega -> IsBounded Omega -> forall (p alpha : NNReal), (n : Real) < p -> (alpha : Real) = 1 - n / p -> forall u : W1pData Omega p, ExtensionData u -> Nonempty (HolderRepresentative u alpha)

domain_and_universes: n : Nat with 1 <= n; Omega : Set (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n)); p and alpha : NNReal; scalar functions; all declarations in Lean universe 0.

encoding_decisions.sobolev_data: Concrete function and weak gradient, both MemLp on volume restricted to Omega, with a distributional integration-by-parts relation.
encoding_decisions.domain_regularness: A bounded-domain W1p extension package is explicit data; no opaque Lipschitz-domain proposition is assumed.
encoding_decisions.representative: A concrete function agreeing almost everywhere with the Sobolev input on Omega.
encoding_decisions.conclusion: HolderOnWith on closure Omega plus a pointwise value bound; both constants are quantitatively tied to the encoded W1p norm.
encoding_decisions.exponent: The equation alpha = 1 - n/p is explicit and the strict hypothesis p > n excludes endpoints.

mutation_tests: removed dimension, exponent, and domain hypotheses
weakened strict p > n to p >= n
excluded the empty-domain boundary case by adding Omega.Nonempty to the conclusion
boundary_policy: The empty domain and zero function remain admitted. Critical/subcritical exponents, unbounded domains, domains without the specified extension data, vector-valued targets, and plain continuity without the Holder exponent and estimate are not substituted.
status_boundary: This node freezes and elaborates the exact selected statement only. ExtensionData is a hypothesis package and no inhabitant of the root conclusion is constructed; no proof, source-audit, obligation-tree, validation, or release credit is claimed.
